exposure: frozen embryo transfer (FET) during an artificial cycle (AC)
Women undergoing FET during a natural cycle with luteal phase support (NC-LPS)
Endometrial preparation scheme (Artificial Cycle (AC) vs. Natural Cycle with Luteal Phase Support (NC-LPS))
Women undergoing frozen embryo transfer (FET) during an artificial cycle (AC)
cohort: Women who underwent FET and subsequent deliveries at a single center between August 2013 and March 2016
finding: While not affecting pregnancy or miscarriage rates, AC-FET was associated with increased risks of ectopic pregnancy, hypertension disorder, cesarean section, and lower live birth rate compared to NC-LPS.
mod_finding: AC-FET was associated with an increased risk of caesarean section compared to NC-LPS.
birth_weight: Birth weight was lower in the AC-FET group compared to the NC-LPS group for multiples (2550 g vs. 2600 g), but not for singletons.
